verdict.rationale: Ramp's in-product AI layer (Ramp Intelligence and its agents) produces suggestions from customer data: AI-filled memos and categories, auto-coding learned from past invoices and team feedback, and memo-suggestions. It also produces insight-style flags, such as real-time anomaly and fraud scanning that flags unclear or risky items for review. Spend-trend and forecasting analysis is documented only through Ramp MCP inside external assistants like Claude or ChatGPT, not as a native in-product insights surface. Missing for 10: a documented in-product analytics or insights experience (spend trends, forecasts, recommendations) beyond coding and anomaly flags, and independent or hands-on corroboration of AI suggestion quality.
